definitions.explanation: Referring to actions, preparations, or information that come before a main event or situation.

examples.japanese: {事前|じぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
{事前|じぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
{事前|じぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただければ→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦{助|たす}かります→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: It would help if you could contact us in advance.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{事|じ} (matter, event) + ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (before)
Literally: "before the matter" → "beforehand"

COMMON PATTERNS:
Can function as:
- Adverb: {事前|じぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜 (in advance ~)
- Noun modifier: {事前|じぜん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (prior ~, advance ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事前|じぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧ - to contact in advance
- {事前|じぜん}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ - advance reservation
- {事前|じぜん}⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ - prior preparation
- {事前|じぜん}{承認|しょうにん} - prior approval
- {事前|じぜん}⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ - pre-registration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事後|じご}→事後：07581_jigo⟧ - after the fact, post-
- ⟦{前|まえ}もって→前もって：03765_maemotte⟧ - in advance, beforehand
- あらかじめ - beforehand, previously
